class.name: The Threadweaver of Crawling Chaos
lore: Wielding the blood of forgotten deities, the Blood of the Outer Gods is no mere sorcerer.
Their magic is spun from writhing threads of madness—an ever-hungering web of eyes, ink, and void.
Their magic is spun from writhing threads of madness—an ever-hungering web of eyes, ink, and void.
Each spell is a whisper from beyond, each strike a fragment of alien will.
Where they tread, reality frays.
Where they cast, sanity breaks.
class.desc_es: La Tejedora del Caos Reptante: teje hilos de sangre de los Dioses Exteriores, lanza sigilos malditos, cuervos y elixires inestables, y potencia sus hechizos dentro de su círculo ritual.

skills.name: Thread of Crawling Chaos
lore: Your magic threads are spun from the blood of the Outer Gods—
a seething web of eyes and thought, ever-watchful and hungry.
👁 Maximum stored energy: 8
❖ Sigil hits awaken fragments of the Crawling Chaos, restoring 0.5 energy.
❖ Other spells draw from this living reservoir of alien will.
skills.desc_es: Pasiva: guardas hasta 8 de energía del Caos Reptante. Cada impacto de un sigilo te devuelve 0,5; tus otros hechizos gastan de esa reserva.

skills.name: Sigil Volley
lore: Unleash a volley of three cursed sigils
Each sigil shatters on impact, feeding the Crawling Chaos within...
⚝ When invoked within the Spell Circle, the volley expands to five cursed sigils.
🗡 {damage} Damage per sigil
👁 Restores 0.5 energy per hit to the Thread of Crawling Chaos
⌛ 1.2 s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Lanza tres sigilos malditos que estallan al impactar y te devuelven energía. Dentro del Círculo de Hechizos son cinco.

skills.name: Crow hex
lore: Summon a spectral crow that relentlessly seeks your foe, marking them with a cursed omen.
The crow strikes for {damage} damage, then silently circles its target, delivering wordless judgment.
Striking the marked enemy again detonates the crow,
dealing {firstauraexplode} damage and
continuously dealing {auraexplode} corruption damage over time within the area.
⚝ When invoked within the Spell Circle, the Crow expands to three.
👁 consumes 4 energy from the Thread of Crawling Chaos
⌛ {cooldown} s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Un cuervo espectral persigue a tu enemigo y lo marca con un presagio maldito. Si vuelves a golpear al marcado, el cuervo estalla y deja una zona que lo corrompe poco a poco.

skills.name: Spell Circle
lore: A ritual circle etched in blood and madness, thrumming with alien will.
While standing within the circle, your spells are enhanced—
warped by the gaze of the Outer Gods into more terrible forms.
👁 consumes 8 energy from the Thread of Crawling Chaos
⌛ {cooldown} s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Un círculo ritual de sangre y locura: mientras estés dentro, tus hechizos se vuelven más terribles. Gasta 8 de energía.

skills.name: Eldritch Elixirs
lore: Hurl three random unstable elixirs forward while propelling yourself backward in a sudden evasive leap.
Each vial manifests a random essence—flame, frost, arcane, or chaos—
each carrying a twisted gift of the Outer Gods...
⚝ When invoked within the Spell Circle, cooldown is halved.
🔮 Arcane Elixir dealing {damagefire} damage
🔥 Fire Elixir dealing {damagefire} damage and burn target for {fireiceduration}s
❄ Icy Elixir dealing {damageice} damage and {slowlevel} level {fireiceduration}s slow
🐙 Chaos Elixir sumoon a Crawling Chaos that keep pulls in nearby foes, deals {damagesummoner} damage
and ends with a devastating strike dealing {lastdamagesummoner} damage.
👁 consumes 2 energy from the Thread of Crawling Chaos
⌛ {cooldown} s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Lanzas tres elixires inestables al azar (fuego, hielo, arcano o caos) mientras saltas hacia atrás. Dentro del círculo, el tiempo de espera se reduce a la mitad.

skills.name: Doomspike
lore: Summon three abyssal spears, each hurled in succession to impale your foes.
Each strike delivers {damage} and knocks back enemies,
feeding the creeping madness within you.
⚝ When invoked within the Spell Circle.
⚝ Your each attack causes three spears to rain around the target,
⚝ dealing {damageincircle} and {damageincircle2} damage and rooting the enemy.
⚝ consumes 0.5 energy from the Thread of Crawling Chaos.
👁 consumes 3 energy from the Thread of Crawling Chaos
⌛ {cooldown} s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Invocas tres lanzas abisales que se arrojan una tras otra, hieren y empujan. Dentro del círculo, cada golpe hace llover lanzas alrededor del objetivo y lo inmoviliza.

skills.name: Abyssal Crucible
lore: Summon a abyssal crucible at your target, dealing {firstdamage} damage.
The crucible continuously pulls nearby enemies toward itself, dealing {damage} damage.
If the crucible is struck by Eldritch Elixirs, it explodes,
dealing {firstdamageexplode} damage and
continuously dealing {damageexplode} corruption damage over time within the area.
⚝ When invoked within the Spell Circle, the Outer God’s projection manifests.
Enemies around the target are first bound by skeletal chains, rooting them in place,
before the projection unleashes {damageincircle} damage.
👁 consumes 4 energy from the Thread of Crawling Chaos
⌛ {cooldown} s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Invocas un crisol abisal sobre tu objetivo que atrae y hiere sin parar a los enemigos cercanos. Si le aciertas con un elixir, estalla y corrompe la zona.
